mainEntity.name: How do glass walls improve interior spaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Glass walls significantly enhance interior spaces by maximizing natural light, creating a more open and spacious feel, and improving visual connectivity between different areas. They allow light to penetrate deeper into a building, reducing the reliance on artificial lighting and potentially lowering energy costs. In commercial settings, glass walls can foster collaboration and transparency among teams. While they offer an aesthetic and functional advantage, clients should consider the level of privacy required for each area, as fully transparent glass may not be suitable for all applications without additional treatments like frosting or switchable glass.
